device.description: 12-bit 50 kSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with internal 2.5 V reference and I2C interface
device.note: ads7828.pdf (SBAS181C) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3-4 electrical characteristics (2.7 V and 5 V: conversion time 6 us, straight binary, hardware address 10010), p.11 address byte, command byte, Table I power-down selection, Table II channel selection, p.12 initiating conversion, reading data (Figure 3), p.13 HS mode (Figure 4), p.14 internal reference; ads7828-q1.pdf (SBAS456B) p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions for the -Q1 part

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the last command byte (SD C2 C1 C0 PD1 PD0 X X); no read-back, reset value not documented

commands.name: Command Byte
commands.note: Table II: C2-C0 select CH0/CH2/CH4/CH6 (C2=0) or CH1/CH3/CH5/CH7 (C2=1) as +IN; the map gives the +IN channel in both SD modes

pages: ads7828.pdf: p.2 (pins), p.3-4 (specs: VDD 2.7-3.6 V and 4.75-5.25 V, 6 us conversion, straight binary, address 10010), p.11 (address/command byte, Tables I-II), p.12 (read format, Figure 3), p.13 (Figure 4), p.14 (reference); ads7828-q1.pdf: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer, single-ended/differential selection (SD, C2-C0 are stored only) and the internal reference (PD1)
power-down selection PD1-PD0 (Table I): every command byte starts a conversion regardless of PD; ADC-off state (PD = 10) not modeled
HS mode master code and clock stretching while the conversion runs; I2C timing limits
vcc covers the two specified supply ranges (2.7-3.6 V and 4.75-5.25 V) as one range 2.7-5.25 V; the 3.6-4.75 V gap is not specified by the datasheet
CTRL reset value is not documented (0 used; the datasheet says the internal reference is off at power-on, which matches PD1 = 0)
reads before any command byte: the datasheet says data can only be read once a conversion has been initiated; the model returns the 0 V code
variants: ADS7828-Q1 (ads7828-q1.pdf, ADS7828EIPWRQ1): same pinout, protocol and timing; ROC table gives VDD 2.7-3.6 V / 4.75-5.25 V. ADS7830 is the 8-bit sibling (own spec).
